name: Nightlight
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. for children. Activates a soft bioluminescent glow in dermal augments during darkness — enough light to see by, gentle enough to sleep next to.
observed_behavior: Triggers low-level photonic emission from synthetic skin augments during dark conditions. The glow is warm amber and pulsates slowly.
story_hooks: A child glows faintly in the dark and other children come to sleep near them — the E.L.F. has created a beacon for frightened kids
